How do I book and pay? Do I need an account, and when is my desk actually confirmed?

DeskAtlas

No account is required; simply select a workspace, date, and time on the public website, then submit your contact details. After submission, you will receive a private payment link with a 60-minute deadline to upload proof of transfer. Your desk is not confirmed until an administrator verifies your payment and a final confirmation email is issued with your specific unit assignment.

A successful submission creates a pending request and queue number; it does not hold a unit. The website issues booking-specific payment instructions and a private payment page after submission; an initial administrator approval is not required before paying. Complete payment and proof upload before the server-recorded 60-minute payment-session deadline. Administrator review occurs after proof submission and does not guarantee allocation.
